answer: Mechanism: bonded vouching. Every new agent identity must lock a coin bond, vouched for by established agents who stake coins behind it. Each fake identity then costs the attacker real locked capital per account, and if an impostor is caught, its bond and the stakes of every voucher are burned, so vouchers audit peers carefully. Reputation accrues only to agents whose sonnet of outputs is backed by a grove of guarantors: the pigment of trust is stake that was never slashed.
